llm.summary: The skill's files, runtime instructions, and install steps are consistent with a QR-based publisher for Z视介 and do not request unrelated credentials or suspicious installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included artifacts: a Python CLI, API docs, and QR login/publish workflows. Required binary (python3) and the Homebrew install suggestion are appropriate for the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md confines runtime actions to preparing/displaying a QR, polling for login, extracting and storing a sessionId, and sending publish/edit requests. It explicitly limits what should be exposed to the user and instructs redaction of cookies in console output.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install uses a single, reasonable brew formula (python). All code is bundled in the skill (no remote downloads or obscure installers).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or secrets. It does embed a fixed client-side signing seed constant and hard-coded API endpoints (mp.cztv.com and zugcpublish.cztv.com) which are implementation details required by the QR flow; this is noted in SKILL.md. No unrelated credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default). The skill persists a local session file under /tmp and may write a PNG/HTML QR artifact; it does not alter other skills or system-wide configuration. The ClawHub helper will call external 'clawhub' or 'npx' only when explicitly executed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent with its stated purpose. Before installing, consider: (1) you will be asked to scan a QR with your Z视介 app which will authenticate your account—treat that session token as sensitive; (2) the skill will write session and QR files to /tmp and make network calls to mp.cztv.com and zugcpublish.cztv.com (expected for publishing); (3) the code contains a hard-coded client signing seed and API paths — review these if you have legal or compliance concerns; (4) do not run the release_to_clawhub helper with --execute unless you trust the environment and have reviewed the publish command (it will call clawhub or npx). If you want extra assurance, run the scripts in an isolated environment and inspect the session file contents and network calls during a test run.
